basic_details.job_title: DHS Nilgiris Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 33 Audiologist, Radiographer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Health Society, Nilgiris District, under the Medicine and Public Welfare Department, has invited completed applications for 33 completely temporary contract posts in 12 categories, with pay of Rs. 11000/- to Rs. 23000/-. The posts are in the Government Medical College Hospital, urban wellness centres and urban government primary health centres of Nilgiris district. Applications go directly or by speed post to the District Health Officer, Udhagamadalam, and must reach him by 5 PM on 7 December 2026.

age_limit.details: Blood Bank Technician: 35 year & Below. District Account Assistant: preferably less than 45 Years. Multipurpose Hospital Worker/ Support Staff: 45 Years. | The notice prints no age limit for the other nine posts, and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: About the Nilgiris District Health Society
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Nilgiris District works under the Medicine and Public Welfare Department. This notice fills vacant posts at the Government Medical College Hospital (GMCH) Udhagamandalam, urban wellness centres and urban government primary health centres in the district. The notice is signed by the District Collector, Nilgiris District, with the District Health Officer named as the office receiving applications.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 33 vacancies in 12 posts. The number of posts is subject to change, as the notice states. The notice prints no category-wise break-up of these vacancies.

rows.place_of_vacancy: Maniapuram, Hosatty, Jegathala, Moosapuri, Hulichal, Anaipallam, Yedappalli, Morigal, RK Puram, Kundhaladi

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Special Educator for Behavioural Therapy: the person should have live RCI (Rehabilitation Council of India) registration with a valid number. Blood Bank Technician: must have a good physique, good vision and capacity to do outdoor work. Blood Bank Technician: 35 year & Below. District Account Assistant: preferably less than 45 Years. Multipurpose Hospital Worker/ Support Staff: 45 Years. The notice prints no age limit for the other nine posts, and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification_required: A Bachelor degree in audiology and speech language pathology/B.SC(Speech and hearing) From RCI Recognized institute
A Bachelor degree in audiology and speech language pathology/B.SC(Speech and hearing) From RCI Recognized institute
High School and Diploma or equivalent, complete a certificate programme
Certificate in Medical Laboratory Technology Course (One Year duration) undergone in any institution recognized by the Director of Medical Education
Master/Bachelor Degree in Social Work/ Public Administration/ Psychology/Socialogy
Diploma in Nursing Therapist Course (For certificate issued by the Govt of TN Only)
+2 Science Group complete Health inspector Training
Bachelor's/Master's degree in Special Education in Intellectual Disability from a UGC-recognized University
B.Com in Computer knowledge with tally. Knowledge of Accountancy and having tamil and english typing
Should have studied minimum 8th standard and Must able to read and write

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is printed against each post in the vacancy table above, from Rs. 11000/- for Security and Multipurpose Hospital Worker/ Support Staff to Rs. 23000/- for Audiologist-Speech Therapist and Audiologist. The notice mentions no allowances. All posts are filled on contract basis and are completely temporary. The posts will not be made permanent at any time. A contract letter for 11 months is to be given, along with a self-willing undertaking to join the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Nilgiris District Health Society Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the website nilgiris.nic.in. The notice says only applications submitted on the downloaded form will be considered. Fill in the form: post applied for, applicant name, father/husband name, date of birth and age, community, educational qualification, mobile number, and whether experience certificate copies are attached. Sign the form with the applicant's photograph and attach self-attested copies of the certificates. Send the application directly or by speed post to: District Health Officer, No.38 Jail Hill Road, Near CT Scan, Udhagamadalam 643001. Make sure the application is received by 5 PM on 07-12-2026. Self-attested copies of the certificates. Copy of the community certificate and copy of the educational certificate. Applications without these will be rejected. Copy of the experience certificate, if any. Undertaking (self-willing consent letter) to join the post and a contract letter for 11 months.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Original documents and experience certificates must be produced at the interview, as printed on the application form. Applications without community and educational certificate copies will be rejected. The number of posts is subject to change. The posts are temporary and will not be made permanent at any time.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Nilgiris District Health Society Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 33 vacancies in 12 posts. MTM Health Inspector and Multipurpose Hospital Worker/ Support Staff have 10 each, Security has 3, Radiographer has 2 and the other eight posts have 1 each.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications are welcome up to 5 PM on 07-12-2026. The notice says they must be received by that time.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the application form from nilgiris.nic.in, fill it in and send it with self-attested certificate copies, directly or by speed post, to the District Health Officer, No.38 Jail Hill Road, Near CT Scan, Udhagamadalam 643001.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Security post?
faq.answer: The Security post requires 8th Pass or equivalent. There are 3 vacancies at GMCH Udhagamandalam, with pay of Rs. 11000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for MTM Health Inspector?
faq.answer: The MTM Health Inspector post requires +2 Science Group complete Health inspector Training. There are 10 vacancies, with pay of Rs. 17000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: It differs by post: Blood Bank Technician 35 year & Below, District Account Assistant preferably less than 45 Years, and Multipurpose Hospital Worker/ Support Staff 45 Years. No limit is printed for the other posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Rs. 11000/- (Security, Multipurpose Hospital Worker/ Support Staff) to Rs. 23000/- (Audiologist-Speech Therapist, Audiologist). Radiographer gets Rs. 17000/- and District Account Assistant Rs. 19000/-.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the posts are on contract basis and completely temporary, and they will not be made permanent at any time. A contract letter for 11 months is to be given.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Send self-attested copies of the certificates, including the community certificate and the educational certificate, and an experience certificate copy if any. Applications without community and educational certificate copies will be rejected.

faq.question: Q10. Where are the Multipurpose Hospital Worker/ Support Staff posts?
faq.answer: Eight posts are at GMCH Ooty -8, one is at T. Oranally (Siddha) and one is at Kadanadu.
